meaning:
1) to be or become or grow lean
1a) (Qal) to make lean
1b) (Niphal) to be made lean

elsewhere.note: “It will happen in that day that the glory of Jacob will be made thin, and the fatness of his flesh will become lean.
Yahweh will be awesome to them, for he will famish all the gods of the land. Men will worship him, everyone from his place, even all the shores of the nations.
